sections.title: A room for *storing food*

image.alt: The Larder’s patio, with umbrellas and an American flag on the corner of the building

body: The Larder takes its name from the old English word for “pantry”, a nod to Manuel Verney-Carron’s European heritage and to being the place for provisions in the neighborhood.

Locally sourced dishes and specialty food items harken back to the way food used to be prepared: cooking for friends and neighbors, with techniques that let the ingredients speak for themselves. Art by local artists hangs throughout the restaurant.

items.q: Can I book a private party?
items.a: Yes. We are closed to the public on Mondays and Tuesdays, but would love to host your birthday dinner, special occasion or corporate party, indoors or outdoors. Rates depend on the date, how long you need the space, group size and menu. Call (803) 599-5149 with your name, the type of event, the date and the number of guests.
Every week: new dishes and a cocktail special, posted on the Specials page.
